openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: 2.4GHz and 5 GHz router with 5 gigabit ports, 880 MHz processor, 16 MBytes Flash, 128 MBytes RAM, WiFi AC, one USB 3.0 port
openwrt_wiki.Versionen: H/W rev A1: Broadcom BCM47081A0, not supported; H/W rev B1: Mediatek MT7621AT, supported
openwrt_wiki.Versionserkennung: barcode on the bottom of the box and on the router itself (Fotos auf der Seite)
Known Issues: WiFi slower than vendor firmware on <=17.01.2 (all MT7612E devices), improved on snapshots > ~2017-07-20 and releases >17.01
WiFi on 2.4 GHz has major issues when badly shielded USB3.0 hardware is attached
WiFi range of the internal antennas is ok, can be improved by adding external antennas
openwrt_wiki.Recovery Mode: D-Link "Emergency Room" im Bootloader, bleibt nach OpenWrt erhalten. Reset (Unterseite) gedrueckt halten beim Einstecken des Stroms bis Power-LED blinkt (~10 s), ~30 s warten, Rechner an LAN1, 192.168.0.2/24, http://192.168.0.1; per curl: curl -v -i -F "firmware=@...-squashfs-factory.bin" 192.168.0.1. Immer factory.bin, nicht sysupgrade.bin.
openwrt_wiki.OEM Flash: MX25L12805D (c2 2018c220) 16384 KB; Partitionen u-boot 0x0-0x30000, boot env, devdata, devconf, upgrade, rootfs, mydlink 0xf60000-0xfe0000, langpack 0xfe0000-0x1000000
openwrt_wiki.Serial: Serial header is JP1, already soldered; TTL 3.3V; Pinout: TX, GND, 3v3, empty, RX; 57600 8N1, no flow control
openwrt_wiki.LEDs: 2 zweifarbige LEDs: Power (GPIO 13 orange, 15 gruen), Planet/WAN (GPIO 14 orange, 16 gruen)
openwrt_wiki.dmesg 15.05: SoC MT7621 ver:1 eco:3, MIPS 1004Kc, 4 CPUs (2 Kerne x 2 Threads), CPU Clock 880MHz, RAM 131072K, console=ttyS0,57600, mx25l12805d 16384 KB, PCIe0/1 mit 14c3:7662 (MT7612 / MT7602), PCIE2 leer, xHCI 2+1 Ports
openwrt_wiki.Disassembly: bottom screws under the rubber pads; top screws hidden under a sturdy sticker
